name: Direct Isosurface Rasterization
aliases: Direct Isosurface Rasterization via Task and Mesh Shaders
definition: A rasterization-based approach for direct rendering of isosurfaces that avoids intermediate explicit mesh storage by leveraging task and mesh shaders to identify subvolumes containing isosurface geometry and extract primitives on the fly for direct consumption by the rasterizer.
summary: Direct Isosurface Rasterization renders isosurfaces by extracting transient triangles via task and mesh shaders, avoiding intermediate mesh storage to reduce memory bandwidth and storage requirements.
